formattedAddress: No. 20號, Lane 235, Zhongzheng Rd, Fulin Village, Shilin District, Taipei City, Taiwan 111

text.text: The BOGO free matcha soft serve was great, and low on the sugar. The matcha mille crepe cake had so much matcha and so little sugar it was a too bitter for me but hubby loved it that way. There was a thick layer of matcha powder on the cake so be careful not to inhale it when you eat it.

text.text:
Pleasant establishment that offers a plethora of macha and green tea related sweets. We tried some macha sponge cake, macha mille crepe, macha tea and macha - strawberry latte and all of them were lovely, however the cake was slightly dry, while the intense green color also suggests some food coloring since baked macha will lose most of its color.

Seating is available on the 2nd floor, guests need to carry their order on their own though. Card payment is available too.
